name: Salinas
source:
“Such a charming creature you are… Even the face you make in despair only fuels my desire.”

Head of the Meidi family, one of the three great noble houses.
As chairman of the noble council and the kingdom’s highest-ranking mage, his brilliance is matched only by his versatility.
But behind his courteous words lies a heart of cruelty—he takes pleasure in acts that strip others of their humanity.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/character/]the official website[/url].]
